T021.title: Implement RegulatoryReporter service
T021.description: Auto-generates daily/weekly MiFID II reports in XML/JSON format. Integrates with ESMA endpoints (mock endpoint in tests). Stores reports and acknowledgments in regulatory_reports table.
T021.output: Automated regulatory reporting engine with mock ESMA API simulation

T022.title: Create ModelGovernanceService
T022.description: Tracks each AI/ML model version, hyperparameters, performance metrics. Ensures full SR 11-7 compliance (traceability + reproducibility). Generates model governance dashboard at /metrics/models.
T022.output: Central registry for all models + explainability compliance

T023.title: Add ComplianceDashboard
T023.description: Displays audit logs, trade counts, flagged transactions, model risk scores. Exposes /dashboard/compliance endpoint (authenticated).
T023.output: Interactive web dashboard visualizing compliance and audit data

T024.title: Add AutomatedSanctionsChecker
T024.description: Integrate sanctions list validation (mock OFAC dataset). Prevents trading on blacklisted assets or counterparties.

T025.title: Extend data layer to handle multiple asset classes
T025.description: Add schemas for equities, forex, crypto, and derivatives (market_assets table). Support unified data ingestion API with source tagging.
T025.output: Multi-asset compatible data model and API

T026.title: Implement MarketDataRouter
T026.description: Routes incoming data to correct feed handler (Binance, IBKR, Polygon, etc.). Supports WebSocket connections and failover recovery.
T026.output: Robust, low-latency market data distribution layer

T027.title: Add support for derivatives trading
T027.description: Create FuturesOrder and OptionsOrder models. Integrate pricing via Black-Scholes (for testing only).
T027.output: Derivative trading support in strategy execution engine

T028.title: Develop PortfolioManager
T028.description: Unified portfolio view across all asset classes. Real-time unrealized P&L, margin usage, and exposure.
T028.output: Multi-asset portfolio management module with API /portfolio

T029.title: Add PerformanceAttribution module
T029.description: Breaks down performance by strategy, asset, and period. Generates daily/weekly attribution reports (PDF via ReportLab).
T029.output: Analytics layer quantifying source of P&L and drawdowns

T030.title: Integrate MLPerformanceMonitor
T030.description: Tracks predictive accuracy, drift detection, and feature importance. Alerts when model performance degrades beyond threshold.
T030.output: ML observability framework tied into CloudWatch + Prometheus

T031.title: Create ExecutionAnalyzer
T031.description: Analyzes order slippage, latency, and execution quality. Computes effective spread vs. market benchmarks.
T031.output: Execution performance analytics with FastAPI endpoint /metrics/execution

T032.title: Optimize for sub-second execution latency
T032.description: Async batching for order placement. Redis stream pipeline for real-time updates. Tune FastAPI workers and Celery concurrency.

T033.title: Implement DisasterRecoveryManager
T033.description: Multi-region database replication (AWS RDS). Periodic failover tests (simulate outages).
T033.output: Disaster recovery procedures with automatic failover

T034.title: Add DataLakeExporter
T034.description: Export anonymized trading data to AWS S3 for analysis. Include metadata for compliance and ML retraining.
T034.output: Secure data export system with anonymization policies

T035.title: Introduce APIKeyManager
T035.description: Secure API key issuance and rotation for external integrations. JWT-based authentication for all critical endpoints.
T035.output: Hardened security for integrations and third-party access

T036.title: Final System Validation & Benchmark
T036.description: Run end-to-end simulation: market data → AI → order → audit → risk → reporting. Measure: latency, throughput, data integrity, audit completeness. Generate /docs/final_validation_report.md with metrics.
